stemMd: A tutoring centre reports that its students’ scores rose after enrolment and concludes that tutoring caused the improvement. Which question would best evaluate this inference?

options.label: A
options.textMd: How far is the centre from the nearest bookstore?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Does the centre keep its classrooms clean?

options.label: C
options.textMd: How did comparable students who did not receive the tutoring change over the same period?

options.label: D
options.textMd: How many colours are used in the centre’s brochure?

options.label: E
options.textMd: Were the students pleased to see higher scores?

explanationMd: A comparable untreated group estimates improvement that may occur through maturation, practice, or schooling without the tutoring, testing attribution rather than the existence of the increase.

distractorRationale.b: Cleanliness alone does not isolate the score effect.
distractorRationale.e: Satisfaction does not explain what caused the rise.
distractorRationale.a: Distance is not linked to the proposed causal comparison.
distractorRationale.d: Brochure design does not establish a counterfactual.
